result.detail: No assumptions are used: rst_n, en and clr are free every cycle, so there is nothing to over-constrain. DC-RANGE is asserted only after a reset has been seen, because the specification says 'after reset' and the RTL has no initial value. No abstraction is used. The proof is meant as prove-mode k-induction (smtbmc, depth 140). formal.cover reuses the same setup, so the engine stays smtbmc; abc pdr would not run in cover mode. If run time at depth 140 is a problem, a fallback is to drop the LIMIT 127 instance's post-reset covers and lower the depth to about 110, stating that the 127 wrap is then covered only through derived antecedents. The RTL file is referred to only by its own name, deep_counter.v, and is not rewritten.; stripped undeclared citations from files: [req:DC-PARAM]
